name: Lemon-Tahini Chicken Thighs with Tomato, Cucumber & Feta Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
3 small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a small bowl. Add salt and pepper, then stir to combine the lemon seasoning. (Reserve lemons for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, transfer to the baking sheet, and sprinkle with lemon seasoning on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until chicken is golden and cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice half of the lemons into the small reserved bowl. Juice the remaining lemons into a large bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide parsley between the two bowls, then set the large bowl aside for later use.
Add tahini, water, vinegar, and spices to the small bowl. Whisk to combine the lemon-tahini sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup tahini
⅓ cup water
1 ½ tsp rice vinegar
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, additional vinegar, salt, and pepper to the large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the bowl.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl, along with the feta, and gently stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates. Drizzle chicken with lemon-tahini sauce and enjoy!
